question: Jumlah deal per stage.
sql: SELECT d.stage, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.stage ORDER BY jumlah_deal DESC

question: total nilai deal tiap stage
sql: SELECT d.stage, sum(d.value) AS total_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.stage ORDER BY total_nilai DESC

question: Rata-rata durasi aktivitas per tipe.
sql: SELECT a.type, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_rata_durasi FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.type ORDER BY rata_rata_durasi DESC

question: jumlah tiket per prioritas
sql: SELECT t.priority, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.priority ORDER BY jumlah_tiket DESC

question: Jumlah pelanggan per segmen.
sql: SELECT c.segment, count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: brp aktivitas per sentimen?
sql: SELECT a.sentiment, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.sentiment ORDER BY jumlah_aktivitas DESC

question: Jumlah sales per tim.
sql: SELECT r.team, count() AS jumlah_sales FROM sales_reps AS r GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY jumlah_sales DESC

question: Jumlah sales per wilayah sales, urut abjad wilayah.
sql: SELECT r.region, count() AS jumlah_sales FROM sales_reps AS r GROUP BY r.region ORDER BY r.region

question: jumlah pelanggan per status
sql: SELECT c.status, count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY c.status ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: Jumlah tiket per status.
sql: SELECT t.status, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.status ORDER BY jumlah_tiket DESC

question: Nilai deal terbesar di tiap stage?
sql: SELECT d.stage, max(d.value) AS nilai_terbesar FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.stage ORDER BY nilai_terbesar DESC

question: Total durasi aktivitas per tipe aktivitas
sql: SELECT a.type, sum(a.duration_minutes) AS total_durasi FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.type ORDER BY total_durasi DESC

question: jumlah deal per rep_id, 10 teratas
sql: SELECT d.rep_id, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.rep_id ORDER BY jumlah_deal DESC LIMIT 10

question: Total aktivitas per customer_id, tampilkan 5 teratas.
sql: SELECT a.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.customer_id ORDER BY jumlah_aktivitas DESC LIMIT 5

question: Jumlah deal per sales (id dan nama), urut terbanyak.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY jumlah_deal DESC

question: Siapa 5 sales dengan omset tertinggi?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY total_omset DESC LIMIT 5

question: top 3 sales dgn rata2 nilai deal won terbesar
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY rata_rata_nilai DESC LIMIT 3

question: Sales mana yang punya lebih dari 40 deal lost?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'lost' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING jumlah_lost > 40 ORDER BY jumlah_lost DESC

question: Pelanggan mana yang punya lebih dari 5 deal? Tampilkan id, nama, dan jumlahnya.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING jumlah_deal > 5 ORDER BY jumlah_deal DESC

question: 5 pelanggan dengan tiket terbanyak?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY jumlah_tiket DESC LIMIT 5

question: Top 10 pelanggan berdasarkan total nilai deal won.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY total_omset DESC LIMIT 10

question: Pelanggan mana yang total durasi aktivitasnya paling kecil? Ambil 5.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, sum(a.duration_minutes) AS total_durasi FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY total_durasi ASC LIMIT 5

question: omset per perusahaan, 10 terbesar
sql: SELECT c.company, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.company ORDER BY total_omset DESC LIMIT 10

question: Rata-rata nilai deal per segmen pelanggan.
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY rata_rata_nilai DESC

question: Jumlah aktivitas per tim sales.
sql: SELECT r.team, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY jumlah_aktivitas DESC

question: omset per tim, urut terbesar
sql: SELECT r.team, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY total_omset DESC

question: Rata-rata jumlah deal per sales di tiap tim? Hitung dari jumlah deal dibagi jumlah sales unik per tim.
sql: SELECT r.team, round(count() / uniqExact(r.rep_id), 2) AS rata_rata_deal_per_sales FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY rata_rata_deal_per_sales DESC

question: Median nilai deal per stage.
sql: SELECT d.stage, median(d.value) AS median_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.stage ORDER BY d.stage

question: Persentil 90 durasi aktivitas per tipe.
sql: SELECT a.type, quantile(0.9)(a.duration_minutes) AS p90_durasi FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.type ORDER BY a.type

question: kuantil 0.75 nilai deal per segmen pelanggan
sql: SELECT c.segment, quantile(0.75)(d.value) AS p75_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY c.segment

question: Median waktu resolusi tiket per prioritas (jam).
sql: SELECT t.priority, median(t.resolution_time_hours) AS median_jam FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.priority ORDER BY t.priority

question: Rata-rata waktu resolusi tiket per prioritas, bulatkan 2 desimal.
sql: SELECT t.priority, round(avg(t.resolution_time_hours), 2) AS rata_rata_jam FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.priority ORDER BY rata_rata_jam DESC

question: Berapa pelanggan unik per tipe aktivitas?
sql: SELECT a.type, uniqExact(a.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.type ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: jumlah pelanggan unik yg punya tiket, per prioritas
sql: SELECT t.priority, uniqExact(t.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.priority ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: Jumlah sales unik yang menangani deal per stage.
sql: SELECT d.stage, uniqExact(d.rep_id) AS jumlah_sales FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.stage ORDER BY d.stage

question: Per perusahaan, tampilkan jumlah pelanggan, hanya perusahaan dengan lebih dari 1 pelanggan, 10 teratas.
sql: SELECT c.company, count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY c.company HAVING jumlah_pelanggan > 1 ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC LIMIT 10

question: Stage mana yang total nilainya di atas 10 juta?
sql: SELECT d.stage, sum(d.value) AS total_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.stage HAVING total_nilai > 10000000 ORDER BY total_nilai DESC

question: Tipe aktivitas dengan rata-rata durasi lebih dari 30 menit.
sql: SELECT a.type, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_rata_durasi FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.type HAVING avg(a.duration_minutes) > 30 ORDER BY rata_rata_durasi DESC

question: Rekap deal won per tahun: jumlah dan total nilai.
sql: SELECT toYear(d.closed_date) AS tahun, count() AS jumlah_deal, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY tahun ORDER BY tahun

question: omset per bulan tahun ini
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Jumlah tiket per minggu dalam 8 minggu terakhir.
sql: SELECT toStartOfWeek(t.created_at, 1) AS minggu, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= subtractWeeks(now(), 8) GROUP BY minggu ORDER BY minggu

question: Jumlah aktivitas per hari selama 14 hari terakhir.
sql: SELECT toDate(a.timestamp) AS tanggal, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 14) GROUP BY tanggal ORDER BY tanggal

question: Bulan apa (1-12) yang paling banyak aktivitasnya sepanjang waktu?
sql: SELECT toMonth(a.timestamp) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY jumlah_aktivitas DESC LIMIT 1

question: Jam berapa aktivitas paling ramai? Urut dari yang terbanyak.
sql: SELECT toHour(a.timestamp) AS jam, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a GROUP BY jam ORDER BY jumlah_aktivitas DESC

question: Pelanggan baru per kuartal.
sql: SELECT toStartOfQuarter(c.created_at) AS kuartal, count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY kuartal ORDER BY kuartal

question: jumlah deal baru per bulan di 6 bulan terakhir
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.created_date) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.created_date >= subtractMonths(now(), 6) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Segmen pelanggan dan status: jumlah pelanggan per kombinasi keduanya.
sql: SELECT c.segment, c.status, count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY c.segment, c.status ORDER BY c.segment, c.status

question: Jumlah tiket per prioritas dan status.
sql: SELECT t.priority, t.status, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.priority, t.status ORDER BY t.priority, t.status

question: Jumlah aktivitas per tipe dan sentimen.
sql: SELECT a.type, a.sentiment, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.type, a.sentiment ORDER BY a.type, jumlah_aktivitas DESC

question: Jumlah sales per tim dan wilayah.
sql: SELECT r.team, r.region, count() AS jumlah_sales FROM sales_reps AS r GROUP BY r.team, r.region ORDER BY r.team, r.region

question: omset per wilayah sales dan tim
sql: SELECT r.region, r.team, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.region, r.team ORDER BY total_omset DESC

question: Total nilai deal per stage dan segmen pelanggan.
sql: SELECT d.stage, c.segment, sum(d.value) AS total_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY d.stage, c.segment ORDER BY d.stage, c.segment

question: Tiket per segmen pelanggan dan prioritas.
sql: SELECT c.segment, t.priority, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment, t.priority ORDER BY c.segment, t.priority

question: Rata-rata durasi aktivitas per sales (id dan nama), 5 terlama.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_rata_durasi FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY rata_rata_durasi DESC LIMIT 5

question: Sales mana yang punya lebih dari 500 aktivitas?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING jumlah_aktivitas > 500 ORDER BY jumlah_aktivitas DESC

question: Sales dgn demo terbanyak, 3 teratas
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_demo FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.type = 'demo' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY jumlah_demo DESC LIMIT 3

question: Rata-rata probabilitas deal pipeline per stage.
sql: SELECT d.stage, round(avg(d.probability), 2) AS rata_rata_probabilitas FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY d.stage ORDER BY d.stage

question: Total weighted pipeline per sales (id dan nama), 5 teratas.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, sum(d.value * d.probability / 100) AS weighted_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY weighted_pipeline DESC LIMIT 5

question: Nilai deal minimum dan maksimum per segmen pelanggan.
sql: SELECT c.segment, min(d.value) AS nilai_min, max(d.value) AS nilai_maks FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY c.segment

question: Pelanggan mana yang tiket urgent-nya lebih dari 2? Tampilkan id, nama, jumlah urgent.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, count() AS jumlah_urgent FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING jumlah_urgent > 2 ORDER BY jumlah_urgent DESC

question: Sales (id, nama) yang total omset won-nya di atas 2 juta.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING total_omset > 2000000 ORDER BY total_omset DESC

question: Pelanggan mana yang punya lebih dari 3 deal dan total nilainya di atas 400.000?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, count() AS jumlah_deal, sum(d.value) AS total_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING jumlah_deal > 3 AND total_nilai > 400000 ORDER BY total_nilai DESC

question: Sales mana yang deal won-nya lebih dari 30 dan rata-rata nilainya di atas 50000?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_won, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING jumlah_won > 30 AND avg(d.value) > 50000 ORDER BY jumlah_won DESC

question: Per tipe aktivitas: jumlah, total durasi, rata-rata durasi, dan durasi maksimum.
sql: SELECT a.type, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, sum(a.duration_minutes) AS total_durasi, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_rata_durasi, max(a.duration_minutes) AS durasi_maks FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.type ORDER BY jumlah_aktivitas DESC

question: Per segmen: jumlah deal, total omset won, dan jumlah pelanggan unik yang punya deal won.
sql: SELECT c.segment, count() AS jumlah_deal_won, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, uniqExact(d.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY total_omset DESC

question: Per sales (id, nama) hitung jumlah deal, jumlah pelanggan unik yang ditangani, dan total nilai; 10 teratas berdasarkan total nilai.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_deal, uniqExact(d.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan, sum(d.value) AS total_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY total_nilai DESC LIMIT 10

question: Median, p90, dan p99 waktu resolusi tiket per prioritas.
sql: SELECT t.priority, median(t.resolution_time_hours) AS median_jam, quantile(0.9)(t.resolution_time_hours) AS p90_jam, quantile(0.99)(t.resolution_time_hours) AS p99_jam FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.priority ORDER BY t.priority

question: Kuantil 0.95 durasi aktivitas per sales (id dan nama), 5 tertinggi.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, quantile(0.95)(a.duration_minutes) AS p95_durasi FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY p95_durasi DESC LIMIT 5

question: Rata-rata omset per deal won tiap bulan di tahun lalu.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Bulan-bulan tahun ini yang omsetnya di atas 1 juta: tampilkan bulan dan omset.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan HAVING total_omset > 1000000 ORDER BY bulan

question: Jumlah tiket resolved per minggu dan prioritas dalam 4 minggu terakhir.
sql: SELECT toStartOfWeek(t.created_at, 1) AS minggu, t.priority, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status = 'resolved' AND t.created_at >= subtractWeeks(now(), 4) GROUP BY minggu, t.priority ORDER BY minggu, t.priority

question: Hari apa dalam seminggu (1=Senin) yang paling banyak meeting?
sql: SELECT toDayOfWeek(a.timestamp) AS hari, count() AS jumlah_meeting FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'meeting' GROUP BY hari ORDER BY jumlah_meeting DESC LIMIT 1

question: Total omset per kuartal per segmen pelanggan.
sql: SELECT toStartOfQuarter(d.closed_date) AS kuartal, c.segment, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY kuartal, c.segment ORDER BY kuartal, c.segment

question: Per pelanggan (id dan nama) yang punya tiket high atau urgent, tampilkan jumlah tiket dan rata-rata waktu resolusi (jam); 8 pelanggan dengan tiket terbanyak.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, count() AS jumlah_tiket, round(avg(t.resolution_time_hours), 2) AS rata_rata_jam FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.priority IN ('high','urgent') GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY jumlah_tiket DESC LIMIT 8

question: Perusahaan mana yang total omsetnya di atas 300.000 dan punya lebih dari 1 deal won?
sql: SELECT c.company, count() AS jumlah_won, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.company HAVING total_omset > 300000 AND jumlah_won > 1 ORDER BY total_omset DESC

question: Tim mana dengan rata-rata durasi aktivitas tertinggi? Tampilkan tim dan rata-ratanya.
sql: SELECT r.team, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_rata_durasi FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY rata_rata_durasi DESC LIMIT 1

question: Segmen pelanggan mana yang punya tiket terbanyak?
sql: SELECT c.segment, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY jumlah_tiket DESC LIMIT 1

question: Jumlah deal won, jumlah lost, dan total nilai won per wilayah sales.
sql: SELECT r.region, countIf(d.stage = 'won') AS jumlah_won, countIf(d.stage = 'lost') AS jumlah_lost, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won') AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.region ORDER BY total_omset DESC

question: Wilayah sales mana yang punya lebih dari 1000 deal? Tampilkan wilayah dan jumlah deal.
sql: SELECT r.region, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.region HAVING jumlah_deal > 1000 ORDER BY jumlah_deal DESC

question: 5 pelanggan dengan rata-rata durasi aktivitas tertinggi, hanya yang punya minimal 10 aktivitas.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_rata_durasi, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING jumlah_aktivitas >= 10 ORDER BY rata_rata_durasi DESC LIMIT 5

question: Sales mana saja yang rata-rata nilai deal-nya di atas rata-rata seluruh deal? Tampilkan id, nama, dan rata-ratanya.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING avg(d.value) > (SELECT avg(d2.value) FROM deals AS d2 FINAL) ORDER BY rata_rata_nilai DESC

question: Rasio deal won terhadap total deal per segmen pelanggan.
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / count(), 2) AS rasio_won FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY rasio_won DESC

question: Rasio aktivitas sentimen negatif per tipe aktivitas.
sql: SELECT a.type, round(countIf(a.sentiment = 'negative') / count(), 2) AS rasio_negatif FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.type ORDER BY rasio_negatif DESC

question: jumlah deal per customer_id, yang lebih dari 8 deal
sql: SELECT d.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING jumlah_deal > 8 ORDER BY jumlah_deal DESC

question: Total nilai deal per customer_id untuk stage won, 3 terbesar
sql: SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id ORDER BY total_omset DESC LIMIT 3

question: Rata-rata nilai deal per rep_id, urutkan dari yang terendah, 5 saja.
sql: SELECT d.rep_id, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.rep_id ORDER BY rata_rata_nilai ASC LIMIT 5

question: Jumlah tiket per customer_id, hanya yang lebih dari 6 tiket
sql: SELECT t.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id HAVING jumlah_tiket > 6 ORDER BY jumlah_tiket DESC

question: Perusahaan dengan pelanggan churn terbanyak, 5 teratas.
sql: SELECT c.company, count() AS jumlah_churn FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'churned' GROUP BY c.company ORDER BY jumlah_churn DESC LIMIT 5

question: Rata-rata nilai deal lost per segmen pelanggan
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_rata_nilai_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'lost' GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY rata_rata_nilai_lost DESC

question: Total waktu resolusi tiket (jam) per prioritas.
sql: SELECT t.priority, sum(t.resolution_time_hours) AS total_jam FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.priority ORDER BY total_jam DESC

question: Tiket yang resolved: jumlah per prioritas dengan waktu resolusi tercepat.
sql: SELECT t.priority, count() AS jumlah_tiket, min(t.resolution_time_hours) AS tercepat_jam FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status = 'resolved' GROUP BY t.priority ORDER BY t.priority

question: Sales dengan jumlah aktivitas positif terbanyak per tipe aktivitas? Tampilkan 10 baris tertinggi (id, nama, tipe, jumlah).
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, a.type, count() AS jumlah_positif FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.sentiment = 'positive' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name, a.type ORDER BY jumlah_positif DESC LIMIT 10

question: Pelanggan Enterprise dengan total nilai pipeline terbesar, 5 teratas.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, sum(d.value) AS total_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise' AND d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY total_pipeline DESC LIMIT 5

question: Jumlah deal won per sales (id dan nama) tahun ini, 10 teratas
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_won FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY jumlah_won DESC LIMIT 10

question: Berapa jumlah deal per stage khusus yang dibuat tahun ini?
sql: SELECT d.stage, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.created_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY d.stage ORDER BY jumlah_deal DESC

question: jml aktivitas per tipe 30 hari terakhir
sql: SELECT a.type, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 30) GROUP BY a.type ORDER BY jumlah_aktivitas DESC

question: Rata-rata nilai deal per stage.
sql: SELECT d.stage, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.stage ORDER BY rata_rata_nilai DESC

question: Pelanggan unik per segmen yang punya tiket open atau in_progress.
sql: SELECT c.segment, uniqExact(t.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress') GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: Jumlah deal per stage untuk sales tim Inbound.
sql: SELECT d.stage, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE r.team = 'Inbound' GROUP BY d.stage ORDER BY jumlah_deal DESC

question: Per bulan tahun ini: jumlah deal won, total omset, dan rata-rata nilai per deal.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_won, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan
